body:
## What's Changed
* Expand Axiom SDK with new tools and filtering options (#16) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/17
* Fix tool test to use current form state instead of saved definition (#18) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/21
* Add pull request event support to GitHub event source poller by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/22
* Add GitHub/Jira source icons to Projects pages and remove redundant columns by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/23
* Fix Create Report Definition modal failing due to empty promptTemplate (#20) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/24
* Add optional title template field to report definitions (#25) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/26
* Color-code labels based on text value (#27) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/28
* Change dev mode ports from 8080/8888 to 9090/9191 (#29) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/30
* Use pull request title as project name instead of repo#number (#32) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/38
* Add project type icon to Projects table name column (#34) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/39
* Set project type to issue or pull-request based on event source (Fixes #33) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/41
* Add toggle to hide completed projects from Projects list (#35) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/40
* Fix AI Assistant message input not shrinking after submit (#37) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/42
* Fix TransactionRequiredException in ManagerService during pipeline event processing (#31) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/43
* End-to-end activity tracing and execution lineage (#36) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/60
* Add real-time SSE updates to Trace Detail page by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/61
* Split pipeline transaction to avoid holding DB connection during AI call (#44) by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/62
* Add trace generation for user-triggered project actions by @EricWittmann in https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/pull/63


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Apitomy/apitomy-axiom/compare/v2.1.1...v2.1.2
